reuse.why: Introduces a shared category selection (getBulkBudgetCategories + shouldSkipBulkCategory) used by setZero, the averages and the new last-month action, and reuses getCategoryAverage/getSheetValue, but copyPreviousMonth does not use it and setBulkNMonthAvg re-inlines the sign/average logic of the existing setNMonthAvg instead of calling it.

duplication.why: The saved-template rule exists twice (SQL json_extract in getBulkBudgetCategories and a JS JSON-parse hasSavedTemplate in copyPreviousMonth), the hidden rule twice (SQL and copyPreviousMonth's inline check), and the average-and-negate logic is copied from setNMonthAvg into setBulkNMonthAvg.

placement.why: All logic stays in server/budget/actions.ts with the method registered in app.ts, as the tree does for the other month-wide actions; the exclusion rules are split between SQL and JS helpers, which is acceptable but scattered.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the month-wide actions, the new handler and tests; collapsing the three average actions into setBulkNMonthAvg is a reasonable related refactor.

maintainability.why: Most actions share one selection, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own parallel exclusion chain that ignores includeHiddenCategories, so the next exclusion rule must be added in two differently shaped places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts copyPreviousMonth: applies hidden/template/fixed exclusions inline on getBudgetData rows instead of using getBulkBudgetCategories/shouldSkipBulkCategory, and does not accept includeHiddenCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: hasSavedTemplate (JS JSON parse of template_settings.source === 'ui') reshapes the SQL `COALESCE(json_extract(c.template_settings,'$.source'),'notes') != 'ui'` filter of getBulkBudgetCategories; copyPreviousMonth's hidden/group_hidden check mirrors the SQL hidden filter; setBulkNMonthAvg re-inlines setNMonthAvg's average-and-negate.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories gains includeHiddenCategories (spec-driven); copyPreviousMonth bypasses the shared selection and re-implements all exclusions inline.
